_comment: Single source of truth for all tags used in automation logic

tag_descriptions.potential client: New contact, not yet messaged or engaged
tag_descriptions.high potential: Strong lead — referred, showed interest, or high-value company
tag_descriptions.past client: Previously used services, lapsed — target for re-engagement
tag_descriptions.cold: Imported from Apollo, no prior contact
tag_descriptions.warm: Has responded or engaged at some point
tag_descriptions.do not contact: Opted out or admin-flagged — NEVER send messages

tag_upgrade_rules.cold: Upgrade to 'warm' if they reply to any message
tag_upgrade_rules.warm: Upgrade to 'potential client' if they request a quote
tag_upgrade_rules.potential client: Upgrade to 'active client' when first shipment is booked
tag_upgrade_rules.active client: Downgrade to 'past client' if no activity for 90 days
tag_upgrade_rules.past client: Upgrade to 'active client' when they re-engage
